prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / final single necessary portrait revision.
Image 1 is the portrait TO EDIT. Images 2-5 are crop, palette and hard-cluster style references only (Mara v2, Iwo v1, Leiya v2, Tore v1). Preserve the SAME adult female identity in image 1, including age, face silhouette, hairstyle or cap, eye color and clothing colors. Do not substitute any reference person's face.
Required correction: visibly SHORTEN THE NECK and make the HEAD LARGER within the SAME vertical 74:100 portrait. Redraw the lower jaw/neck/collar region and head placement so the top of hair or cap is at logical y=2, the CHIN is at y=92, and only y=93-99 shows the very short neck and a thin collar. Less than SEVEN logical pixel rows of exposed neck. This is a HEAD PORTRAIT, not a bust. Collar practically touches the base of jaw; no long tube of neck, no chest, no broad shoulders or V-neck. Preserve entire top/side silhouette, no cut-off cap or bun. Use almost full canvas width without squeezing the face. This change is mandatory and must be obvious compared with image 1.
Also reduce the eye openings by about 30 percent, with dark upper lids and dark brown irises. Eye whites must be only small muted warm-gray fragments, not large bright almond shapes. Merge hair into broad connected planes, remove tiny scattered strands and repetitive fine highlight stripes. Use large angular cheek/nose planes. No texture noise or dithering, no smooth rendering. Keep an approximately 24-32 color, hard-edged, visibly low-resolution pixel construction that reads on a 74x100 logical grid.
Preserve genuine transparent background outside silhouette, one person only, no text or decorative frame. No hands, tools or scenery.
LODA specific invariants: woman in her thirties, sturdy broad SQUARE jaw and strong cheekbones, broad practical nose, straight heavy brows, dark brown hair in compact low knot, LOW FLAT CLOSE-FITTING charcoal-blue short-brim work cap with a tiny muted PALE PINK-GRAY / GRAY-WHITE chalk-line thread tucked at the brim, never orange, dark-blue work collar. She looks practical and watchful, with firm closed lips, firm nearly STRAIGHT LEVEL BROWS and the smallest asymmetric confidence; not a youthful glamour face. Keep the pale thread readable with 1-2 bright but nonwhite connected logical pixels. Do not remove cap or knot. Her current neck is too long: compress to the required very short strong 5-7 logical rows. The collar should almost touch jaw.
Independent review correction: flatten the existing cap crown visibly; it must be low and close to head, not a tall soft puffy cap. Preserve a BROAD SQUARE female face, NOT an elongated face. Enlarge the head while maintaining its broad width-to-height ratio and reducing neck; do not stretch face vertically. Expression must be DISTINCT from Jotin: level fairly straight brows with a purposeful slight downward set, no raised worried inner brows or pleading concern. The chalk-line is a small low-brightness pale pink-gray connected cluster, not a warm orange stick or white badge.
